guarantees.claim: On every posedge clk_i with rst_ni high, the outputs low_then_high_q, dom_out_low_q, dom_in_low_q are updated to the values of low_then_high_d, dom_out_low_d, dom_in_low_d, respectively.
When rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset), all three registers are cleared to 0 immediately.

uncertain_points.claim: The purpose of the signals low_then_high_*, dom_out_low_*, dom_in_low_* is unclear from this register block alone. They may relate to domain crossing or security countermeasures, but without context it is uncertain whether the design intent (e.g., security state tracking) is correctly implemented across the full module.
uncertain_points.risk: Could lead to incorrect security domain isolation or side-channel leakage if the signals' usage is mis-specified elsewhere.
